confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Kanazawa cost-of-living aggregators. The aggregators disagree. Meal and coffee figures come from them and are reasonably solid. The beer estimate comes from aggregator pint prices of about $3 to $4, adjusted slightly for restaurant pricing. Cocktail and wine were not searched. I estimated them from the local relationship to beer, as roughly 1.5 to 1.7 times a restaurant beer. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. I did not check any listings. Kanazawa hotel prices are volatile with tourism demand. The RBA 18 Nov 2026 rate of 0.6720 is the latest one I confirmed on an RBA page. A 19 Nov figure of 0.6677 appeared in the RBA table but I could not confirm it elsewhere.
comparable_city_reasoning: Kanazawa is a mid-sized Japanese tourist city. Aggregators put its prices about 4 to 11 percent below the Japan average. Kyoto and Takayama were the comparison basis for accommodation, with Kanazawa slightly cheaper than Kyoto.
